data.name: Ayanith
data.gender_notes: Ayanith is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit root 'ayana' meaning 'to go', 'ayan' meaning 'goer', 'ayin' meaning 'to ascend' and 'ith' meaning 'lord'. Ayanith is a name of a Hindu deity, often depicted as a warrior riding a chariot, who ascends to protect and lead his people. The name Ayanith carries the meaning “Ascender, leader, protector” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ayanith usually hope their child will grow to embody ascender, leader, protector and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Ayanith belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Ascender, leader, protector.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ayanith total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
